text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Agnes Digital is running in a
scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's progressing slowly, with Agnes
Digital buried
right in the middle of the
pack.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is still grouped up as they
round the
fourth corner! Ohhh, what's
this?! Agnes Digital
has broken free!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Right?! I felt like I could really go for it
today, so
I did!
choice_data_list: 集団からよく抜け出せたな
集団からよく抜け出せたね
choice_data_list_en: Good job breaking out of the pack.
Good job breaking out of the pack.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Normally, I freeze up at the thought of

accidentally touching one of the other
runners...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But I was in total control today. I felt
like I could
get through any gap.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I figure it's because of all the muscle I've
put on!
choice_data_list: 安定したいい走りだったぞ！
安定したいい走りだったよ！
choice_data_list_en: That was a solid, steady run!
That was a solid, steady run!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Which is thanks to you! Now it feels so
good to
run!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I can run with other Umamusume without
holding
back, but also without bothering
them!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Pretty soon, I won't be fazed by
anything so long
as I've got your trusty
support!
